name: Horn of Awakening
summary: On the road to Ashenvale, Kerlonian Evershade carries the Horn of Awakening. It stirs him whenever sleep overtakes him.

sections.title: A Remedy for Drowsy Druids
sections.body:
Kerlonian Evershade has only lately awakened from centuries in the Emerald Dream. Still, wakefulness weighs on him. The Druid of the Claw travels south toward Maestra's Post and entrusts the horn to travelers willing to escort him.

When exhaustion takes Kerlonian on the wilderness trail, a clear blast jolts him awake. He gets back on his feet before wild beasts or cultists can reach him.

faq.q: Where is the Horn of Awakening found?
faq.answer: The horn rests inside Kerlonian's Chest beside Kerlonian Evershade's campsite in southern Darkshore, near the Ashenvale border.

faq.q: Why does Kerlonian need the horn to stay awake?
faq.answer: After long ages asleep within the Emerald Dream, Kerlonian struggles with mortal wakefulness. Sudden, deep naps often overtake him while he travels.

faq.q: Where is Kerlonian trying to go?
faq.answer: Kerlonian is trying to reach Maestra's Post in northern Ashenvale to meet Liladris Moonriver.

angles.text: As a druid, you know Druids of the Claw spent generations asleep in the Barrow Dens, communing with the Emerald Dream. Returning to wakefulness can leave them dazed and disoriented.
As a night elf, you can see in Kerlonian's drowsy journey how difficult it can be for your druids to wake after their long slumber in the Emerald Dream.
